reviews.review: 听别人说这个游戏有点老了，所以在我库里吃灰，结果一玩，我觉得画面还可以啊，玩的还很流畅，手感中上，玩法真的丰富，从来没玩过一手剑一手魔法的游戏，最让我震惊的是里面的书，内容好玩，制作组真的用心了
探索到后期比较乏味——开挂——任务错乱，主线触发不了——我的建议是玩这个千万不要开挂，但是我实在懒得开新档再打一遍了，大部分野外随机任务还是比较马桶的
好玩

缺点：1，画质还是差点意思。2，bug太多，各种任务卡bug，还有死灵法师吸血鬼之类，夜莺剑无法锻造，多得说不完。3，周年版非常不稳定，大概玩1小时就要闪退。4，没有简中。
优点：1，代入感极好，制作组呕心沥血编写的虚拟世界，体现在游戏内诸多方面，如大量书，极大的丰富了世界观，npc来自世界各地，旁敲侧击告诉你这里只是天际省，深入刻画各种npc的人生，以及npc自己的生活。2，升级系统十分合理，不仅体现在逻辑上，也体现在游玩过程上，你越使用一个技能，它就会越来越强，直到登峰造极。3，非常自由，选择权在你手里，对话选项不是做出来看着玩的，不仅是任务分支自由，还有就是战斗可以混搭，比如重甲毁法。而且不做等级限制，导致你熟悉套路可以各种开局

My all-time favorite game, but I can only give it one star

I’ve put hundreds of hours into Skyrim across multiple saves. Two of my old playthroughs never hit the Chillrend sound bug at all, but my newest save finally ran into it, and it’s so frustrating.

Chillrend has a looping frost hiss sound when drawn. This bug happens when the audio stop command gets lost during cell changes, loading screens or quick weapon swaps. Unlike Dawnbreaker or most enchanted weapons that only play a short one-off sound, this is a looping effect. Once it glitches out, the sound sticks to your character forever. Sheathe the sword, drop it, even delete it — the noise stays. It survives restarts and save reloads. Open a menu and it quiets briefly, only to come back right after. Pull Chillrend out again while the bug is active and you stack multiple layers of the hiss, which gets painfully loud.

Since I play in third-person, I only noticed this Chillrend audio bug much later, forcing me to load a save from dozens of hours back and wasting days of my playtime.

The vanilla workarounds are janky at best. Using `sexchange` twice or turning into a werewolf can temporarily clear the sound, but it comes back on reload. Worse, `sexchange` breaks the Ranger archery perk and removes its movement speed boost. There’s no reliable native fix in the base game. Trying to force-trigger the stop command by sheathing and teleporting at the same time only makes it worse and adds more overlapping audio.

And it’s not just the Chillrend bug. The Creation Club homes are packed with well-known issues too. Weapon racks and plaques eat stored weapons, many display cases won’t accept gear. Dragon claws float off their mounts. Some adopted kids can’t move in, pets sometimes vanish or get sent to the wrong house. Mannequins lock onto one set of armor, push out any new gear you put on them, and duplicate that old armor when you leave the area and come back. Items jump all over the place every time you enter these homes, way more so than regular Hearthfire houses. Most display cases don’t work properly as displays at all.

Serana also has her own annoying bugs. She will stop following you in basements and can disappear randomly. Her hood duplicates infinitely, stacking hundreds of copies in her inventory and making trading items impossible.

On top of all these bugs, the base game volume is way too low. Compared to nearly every other game, even older ones like GTA V, Skyrim’s overall sound level feels like it’s only one third as loud. Every single time I boot it up, I have to crank my system volume. When I finish playing and jump on TikTok without turning it back down, the sudden blast of sound has startled me and even gotten me complaints from neighbours.
I don’t want to sound harsh, but it’s unbelievable that pirated versions of Skyrim can run better with fewer bugs. The only extra thing this official version offers is the pointless achievement system.

It feels like Bethesda just doesn’t care about polishing these long-standing quality-of-life problems. The community has to make mods to patch everything for them. Players end up doing the dev team’s job instead of just enjoying the game. It’s disappointing. GTA V is just as old, yet it feels polished and optimized. Meanwhile Bethesda chases big projects like Starfield. It’s like taking a warrior and forcing them to slog through boring, drawn-out religious texts.

It is my all-time favourite game, yet also the buggiest. Bethesda is just as arrogant as Valve is with CS2. But my negative review reflects my real experience. I’m here to play a game, to enjoy something as a person, not to suffer and do your work for you.
